Aaj ki baat yeh thi ki parimap kisi band shape ke poore kinaare ki lambai hai, jismein har bhuja ek baar judti hai aur andar ki jagah nahi aati. Rectangle mein lambai aur chaudai do-do baar aati hain, isliye uska parimap 2 × (lambai + chaudai) hai, aur square ka 4 × bhuja. Parimap se ulta square ki bhuja nikalti hai, aur lambai bhi pata ho toh rectangle ki chaudai, aur parimap se hi chakkaron ki doori aur taar ka kharcha nikalta hai. Tumne 60 m parimap wale square ki ek bhuja 60 ÷ 4 = 15 m nikali. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain.
